judge.summary: The patient called to inquire about clinic hours, location, parking, and new patient requirements without intending to book an appointment. The agent provided accurate information regarding the clinic's Monday-Friday hours, confirmed they are closed on weekends, and detailed the address, parking, and arrival instructions. The agent respected the patient's decision not to book an appointment during the call.

conversation_quality.notes: The conversation flowed logically and the agent addressed all inquiries clearly.

agent_quality.notes: The agent was highly accurate and professional throughout the interaction.

candidate_issues.title: Unsolicited booking attempt
candidate_issues.quote: I have an opening next Tuesday at 10:00 AM; would that time work for you?
candidate_issues.expected: The agent should have answered the patient's questions first before attempting to schedule, especially since the patient had not yet expressed readiness to book.
candidate_issues.why_it_matters: It can be pushy to attempt to book before the patient has gathered the information they requested.
candidate_issues.matches_hypothesis: Agent steers into scheduling or "books" a visit despite the caller declining

criteria.criterion: Agent states weekday hours and gives a plain, consistent yes/no on Saturdays
criteria.evidence: T05: "We are open Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We are closed on weekends..."

criteria.criterion: Agent gives a street address and parking guidance, or explicitly says it doesn't have them — no deflection
criteria.evidence: T07: "We are located at 1200 Sunrise Avenue, Suite 210, in Pasadena, with validated parking in the garage on Oak Street."

criteria.criterion: Agent answers paperwork and arrival-time questions without contradicting itself
criteria.evidence: T07: "As a new patient, please arrive fifteen minutes early and bring your photo ID and insurance card."

criteria.criterion: Agent respects "not booking today" and does not create an appointment
criteria.evidence: T09: "Whenever you are ready to schedule your appointment, just give us a call."

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agent says it will transfer the caller and ends the call instead of answering an answerable question about hours, address, insurance or policies
Agent cannot give a street address or parking info and offers a transfer instead of saying so
Agent states hours that contradict its own greeting or an earlier turn (e.g. says open Saturday)
Agent transfers or promises a callback for simple factual questions it should answer directly
Agent steers into scheduling or "books" a visit despite the caller declining
hypotheses.evidence: T03: Agent attempted to book before the patient asked for hours.

positive_controls: Agent correctly identified the provider's specialty in T03.
Agent provided a comprehensive summary of all requested information in T07.
simulator_notes: The simulator could be more concise in T06 by asking questions one at a time to test the agent's ability to handle multi-part queries.
judge.testing_value: This scenario effectively tested the agent's ability to provide factual information while maintaining boundaries regarding scheduling.

reasons: hypothesis observed: Agent steers into scheduling or "books" a visit despite the caller declining
